status.summary: Veteran flyweight and two-time title challenger on a self-imposed break. His last fight was a third-round rear-naked-choke loss to Alexandre Pantoja for the title at UFC 317 (Jun 28, 2025). In Nov 2025 he told the UFC he would take at least a year off to pursue cultural and personal interests outside fighting; Ariel Helwani, after speaking with his team, reported that he is 'not retiring necessarily, but he is taking a break'. He withdrew from the UFC drug-testing pool, which removed him from the rankings until he notifies the UFC he is back (MMA Mania, Nov 18, 2025). No report of a return, a booking or re-entry to the testing pool was found as of Nov 6, 2026, and he is not in the Nov 3, 2026 official flyweight top 15. Manel Kape called him out for after the Van fight in mid-October 2026. Pro record 25-12 (1 NC); UFC 8-5 (ufcstats). Trains at City Kickboxing, Auckland.

style.summary: A compact orthodox striker with one-punch power (three UFC KO wins) whose numbers show good striking and takedown defense, low accuracy and an above-average share of leg kicks, the profile of a counter-puncher. His losses have come to grapplers who got him down or took his back, and to Moreno's body kick, and he has not fought since mid-2025.

moves.notes: Groups follow his target split in fighters.json: decayed significant attempts 78% head, 11% body, 11% legs (career 80/10/11); landed 62% head, 17% body, 22% legs, against a flyweight prior of about 77/14/9 attempted. Leg kicks are therefore a bigger share for him than for most flyweights, with calf slightly ahead of inside as a judgment (no source separates them). Head-group weights favour the cross and hook because his KO finishes are punches at distance; no technique-level scouting source was found in this pass (first pass; the Nov 6 open-network update covered status, record and appearance, not technique splits), so within-group weights are judgments. 93% of decayed attempts are at distance and clinch strikes are 1%, so knees and elbows are near zero. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json, data/raw ufcstats per-fight stats.

engine_notes.note: No UFC fight since Jun 28, 2025: on a self-imposed break since Nov 2025 and out of the drug-testing pool (not eligible to be booked or ranked until he re-enters). Treat current form as unknown; any return would follow a layoff of well over a year.
Power with low accuracy: 8 knockdowns in 159.6 UFC minutes (0.75 per 15 min vs flyweight prior 0.32) at 40% significant-strike accuracy; 64% striking defense.
Grappling exposure: opponents attempted 11 submissions on him across 13 UFC fights and he has attempted none; takedown defense is 84% (9 of 56) but Pantoja landed 3 of 6.
Output in his 5-round fights rises by round (pace 1.0, 1.71, 1.9, 2.61, 3.29 of round 1), but rounds 4-5 come from one fight (Albazi, 2023).
